name: artifact-catalog
description: When Claude publishes a new artifact, asks above the prompt whether to file it in your catalogue (a Notion database and/or an index artifact).

notionDatabase.title: Notion database
notionDatabase.description: URL of the Notion database that lists your artifacts. Leave empty to skip Notion.

indexArtifact.title: Index artifact
indexArtifact.description: URL of an index artifact whose database collection "artifacts" lists your artifacts. Leave empty to skip it.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Comma-separated categories Claude picks from when filing an artifact.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the prompt band and of Claude's reply when it files an artifact.
